## Install

```
brew tap piyushrajput0/mactoys https://github.com/piyushrajput0/MacToys
brew install --cask mactoys
```

Or download the zip below, unzip it, and drag **MacToys.app** into your
Applications folder.

### First launch

macOS will say the developer cannot be verified. That is expected — MacToys is
signed, but not with a $99/year Apple Developer certificate. Open **System
Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway**. You
only do this once.

Then grant **Accessibility** (window snapping, the remapped keys) and **Screen
Recording** (snip and OCR) when asked. Everything else works without granting
anything, and MacToys will not nag you.

Something not working? Menu bar → **Diagnostics** tells you which feature is
stuck and what to do about it.
